source_documents.role: Portuguese audit findings; historical source claims preserved without treating its old execution matrix as current release evidence.
English audit findings and current-state context; current M0 command records supersede its aggregate score for release qualification.
Frozen required criteria and evidence methods.

findings.summary: The current constraints and hygiene records reproduce eight package-depth directories without package.json; the Portuguese audit's older table names four. The current eight-directory observation is retained with the historical four-directory discrepancy explicit.
findings.limitations: No residue was deleted during M0; the count must be resolved by AAA-002 against the exact package-root corpus.

findings.summary: The live weighted-approval classifier still names the removed code-runtime-python path and omits ptc-runtime-python; the canonical Python suite passes only because its fixture asserts the removed path.
findings.limitations: The focused implementation and fixture change remains pending.

findings.summary: The dated dependency catalog and lock still contain workflow-worker-thread, while the live verifier name is valid. The current record preserves the catalog finding but does not claim that every related generated-name observation is a defect.
findings.limitations: AAA-018 must decide the canonical catalog corpus and whether the dependency entry is stale before regeneration or removal.

findings.summary: The source-export inventory finds 279 package manifests exporting ./src/* while their files arrays omit source.
findings.limitations: No publication policy decision has been made.

findings.summary: The M0 ad-hoc count found 87 no-deprecated lines, while the historical report states 85.
findings.limitations: The M0 command explicitly does not establish the canonical corpus; AAA-018 owns the metric definition.

findings.summary: The M0 ad-hoc count found 211 oxlint-disable lines, while the historical report states 205.
findings.limitations: The corpus and exclusion rules are not yet canonical.

findings.summary: The compiler and lint configuration retains correctness off, skipLibCheck true, and verbatimModuleSyntax false.
findings.limitations: No broad configuration change is authorized before owner-grouped migration evidence.

findings.summary: The hygiene aggregate invokes publint without declaring its build prerequisite, and the aggregate currently fails through constraints.
findings.limitations: The standalone and aggregate command contract has not been redesigned.

findings.summary: Static review retains the early WebSocket close resolution, lexical-only static containment, request-local HTTP buffering without an aggregate cap, and dynamic-code surfaces.
findings.limitations: M0 did not claim that static review substitutes for lifecycle, containment, concurrency, CSP, consent, or deployment negative tests.

findings.summary: The audit reports a generated banner name divergence, but the live verify-cordis-api entry point owns that name; the current command therefore records P11 as not reproduced as a defect.
findings.limitations: The historical P11 claim remains preserved and is not silently deleted.

findings.summary: The M0 ad-hoc counts are 57 TODO/FIXME/XXX lines, 866 lines containing the token any, and zero .skip( lines in the selected spec corpus; the historical report states 81, 66, and 8 respectively.
findings.limitations: These measurements are explicitly non-canonical until AAA-018 defines corpus, exclusions, and revision evidence.

findings.summary: Generated catalog files are present in source; the current inventory records paths and sizes instead of assuming the historical examples remain exact.
findings.limitations: The inventory does not decide whether generated source should move outside src or remain with a gate.

findings.summary: Snapshot, expected-output, e2e, coverage, web, and browser benchmark lanes have current failures; aggregate check:all, Windows, Node compatibility, credentialed provider, packed install, and upstream merge rehearsal are explicitly deferred.
findings.limitations: A deferred lane is not a PASS and blocks release qualification until the final candidate supplies evidence.

findings.summary: The client-domain graph verifier reports 38 ownership violations.
findings.limitations: The violations are not yet grouped by owner.

findings.summary: English, Chinese, and pairing module-graph outputs are stale.
findings.limitations: The generator rerun belongs after client ownership changes settle.

findings.summary: Unit tests fail in six files and 16 tests, including spill cleanup under umask 0002 and an orphan-bundle corpus check.
findings.limitations: AAA-004 must reproduce under both relevant umasks before attributing product behavior.

findings.summary: Current custom paths are attributed and the existing policy suite passes, but invalid packageRoots on non-packaged solution types are accepted and not covered.
findings.limitations: A passing exit status is not criterion PASS while the invalid fixture is absent.

findings.summary: Runtime and test text expose detailed timeout behavior while maintained descriptions retain older generic wording, and no owning keyless snapshot scenario is identified.
findings.limitations: The documentation owner and snapshot pair remain to be recorded before implementation.

findings.summary: The custom package manifests use the official repository URL and @deepseek-ai namespace, including two fork-specific packages.
findings.limitations: Namespace, repository identity, registry visibility, and publication authority require a maintainer decision.

findings.summary: English and Chinese community-channel content differs, and the historical implementation report retains undated 1,128/2,259 counts.
findings.limitations: The channel policy and metric source details are undecided.

findings.summary: Local and origin refs agree at capture time, but workflow automation does not fetch and compare deepseek-official/master and the final network-fresh merge rehearsal is deferred.
findings.limitations: The local equality observation is not a proof of future updateability.

quality_criteria.summary: The aggregate check:all was deferred after its failing leaves were reproduced individually.
Unit tests and coverage fail before a coverage qualification is produced.
Snapshot and expected-output suites reproduce generation, adapter, request-count, and ACP stream failures.
Constraints, client-domain, module-graph, source-export, and catalog/residue evidence are not clean.
M0 has static risk evidence but no deterministic lifecycle, containment, aggregate-memory, or dynamic-extension negative-test qualification.
Weighted approval and packageRoots enforcement have false-green gaps, while mirror equality is observed without required automation.
Build and release-family ordering pass; hygiene fails and typecheck, lint, and packed-install lanes remain unqualified.
The ad-hoc static count differs from the historical values, but its own limitation prevents a baseline replacement; AAA-018 must define the canonical corpus.
Shell documentation/snapshot evidence, README semantic parity, historical metric source details, and doc-sync all have open findings.
Benchmark tests pass except for browser cases blocked by missing Chromium; the designated Linux runner has not supplied current evidence.
Current local refs agree, but official-upstream fetch, comparison, and disposable-worktree merge rehearsal remain deferred.
Snapshot, Python expected-output, and e2e evidence expose current failures; no complete Session and dual-SDK compatibility matrix is qualified.
The current candidate is not an immutable release candidate with passing required platform, Node, Web, consumer, packed-install, benchmark, coverage, and credentialed-provider lanes.
A fresh-context critic is scheduled only after remediation and candidate sealing.

quality_bar_reconciliation.reason: All normative source snapshot hashes match the frozen plan and the reconciled .gauntlet/bar.json copy. CMD-AAA-001-016 is explicitly an ad-hoc, non-canonical corpus and therefore does not prove that the frozen AAA-QB-08 baseline is invalid. No criterion or historical revision entry was silently changed.
quality_bar_reconciliation.next_action: Define the canonical corpora and rerun the metrics. If the canonical result disproves AAA-QB-v1.4, append AAA-QB-v1.5 preserving both value sets and the reason for correction.

coverage.validation_method: Parse commands.jsonl; require unique command IDs, existing raw_output files with matching SHA-256, non-empty source_refs; require every direct source_ref to occur in findings or quality_criteria; require every AAA-QB-01..14 criterion and every required_release_lanes entry to have at least one command ID; require every command ID to be referenced by a finding, criterion, or required lane.
